title: Task claims stay visible from claim to merge
acceptance: Another session can tell a task is claimed from its claim until its PR merges or closes, including after the draft becomes ready with the task set to Done.
Parallel agents told to take the top Ready task do not both start the same task.
nextAction: Design a claim signal that survives the draft-to-ready transition (for example, any open PR whose head changes the task record) and update start-session and delegate-task.

evidence.summary: Final review #4 of #643 (finding 7): the claim definition requires a draft PR with the task In progress, which lapses once the task is finalized in the ready PR. Logged 2026-10-27.
